Use case: stylized-concept. A polished landscape 3:2 GAME ENVIRONMENT AND BOSS CONCEPT BOARD for floor 21 of a top-down pixel-art dungeon RPG. Image 1 is ONLY a reference for chunky painterly pixel-art style, material detail, overhead game view, and the board layout; replace all fire themes with the following lightning theme. 
Layout: left 62% shows the complete playable room from a slightly elevated directly overhead RPG perspective, rectangular grid axes aligned horizontally and vertically (not diamond isometric). A small brown-haired adventurer at the foreground opening provides scale, and the boss occupies the upper center with generous empty floor around it. Right 38% on quiet charcoal background shows one larger full-body BOSS portrait at top; two short wall samples; four equal square floor texture samples; four small isolated matching object examples at bottom. All examples fit wholly inside the image. Do not put text, labels, letters or numerals anywhere on the board; HTML will add labels later.
Scene, materials, objects and boss: rain-soaked ancient stone courtyard, cool blue-grey rounded low stone walls, large irregular weathered wet flagstones, faint moss only at edges, a few small shallow puddles. Objects: lightning-split stump, squat stone lightning rod, fallen short copper column, rainwater stone basin. Monster: muscular four-legged lightning wolf-beast with dark indigo and silver-white fur, sharp upright ears, mane shaped like pale-blue lightning, gold fangs, strong paws and long fur tail. Animal rather than humanoid, no wings or armor. A few restrained blue and gold sparks hug the mane.
Usability: 10 by 10 walkable square middle-boss room, very LOW walls no higher than the little adventurer's waist, broad visible stone tops and short wall fronts. Place 6–8 low props near edges, never in the open central four-by-four square or main path. Keep at least 70 percent quiet open floor visible. Floor patterns low contrast, no glowing electric circuit covering the arena. Lightning only on a few accents and the boss; no strobe, no bloom blanket, no ice, no magma, no red fire. Avoid photorealism and smooth 3D; crisp crafted pixel shading, readable at small game size. The drawing is a concept proposal, not an actual screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a landscape 3:2 polished PIXEL ART monster design sheet for a lightning-element Tyrannosaurus rex called Voltyrex (no text in image). Reference 1 ONLY sets the game's rich chunky hand-painted pixel shading. Reference 2 ONLY sets Tyrannosaurus anatomy: huge heavy long rectangular skull, powerful short neck, short two-fingered arms, two muscular hindlegs, thick long horizontal counterbalance tail, forward-leaning dinosaur torso. Preserve this T rex silhouette closely. No wings, no dragon horns, no long serpentine neck, no extra legs, no huge dorsal sail, no upright Godzilla posture.
Design: dark storm-indigo scales with natural slate-grey belly, muted gold lightning-shaped stripes across flanks and heavy jaw, small amber conductive scutes along spine and tail, bright yellow eyes. A few short blue-white arcs hug the jaw and tail, strong silhouette visible without effects. Massive teeth, powerful feet. Layout: left two-thirds one large complete side/three-quarter full-body portrait, tail entirely in frame and feet visible, jaws open in a thunderous roar; right upper quadrant smaller rear three-quarter view showing tail and stripe placement; right lower quadrant head close-up with jaw arcs. Dark plain navy-grey opaque background, soft grounding shadow. Cohesive same individual in all views, no typography or UI. Strong dinosaur anatomy, menacing and majestic but not gory. Purpose is approval of a new 25F final-area boss design; not a sprite atlas.
